harness.migrations_source: reviewed BOM-stripped/asserted compatibility artifacts (same bytes as hosted)

assertion_failures.message: cannot delete storage objects via direct SQL
assertion_failures.observed: no exception thrown; RLS filtered the row instead
assertion_failures.reason: local storage-api v1.26.5 does not install the protect_delete trigger that newer storage releases add; application RLS still blocks the delete

assertion_failures.message: returning users migrated without forced onboarding
assertion_failures.reason: migration 20261008134000 backfills `select id,true from auth.users` at migration time; a fresh DB has zero users at that moment, so the assertion is vacuous locally

not_run.reason: each opens independent TCP sessions via dblink; dblink is not a trusted extension and the local `postgres` role is deliberately non-superuser, so `create extension dblink` fails and the concurrency sessions cannot be established
not_run.note: These are concurrency/contention suites, not RLS or policy suites.
